scientific_integrity: Direct analytic proof given; independently reproducible symbolic identities and finite numerical consistency checks supplied. Biennial behavior itself and the model originate in the cited paper; bibliographic novelty remains provisional pending independent scholarly review.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only two-cycles whose low coverage is below and high coverage is at or above the herd-immunity boundary, with perfectly effective vaccine, positive morbidity, and homogeneous deterministic final-size seasons. No global-basin, noncrossing-cycle, stochastic, imperfect-efficacy, or touching-case stability conclusion is asserted.
title: Exact threshold for alternating herd immunity under perfect vaccine efficacy
